key_achievements: Gold Medals from both the Society of Interventional Radiology and the Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe, honorary professor at the Third Beijing University School of Medicine, Professor Titular of the Faculty of Medicine, University of Buenos Aires, Argentina, honorary member of the Japanese and Czech Societies of Interventional Radiology and the European College of Radiology, Distinguished Fellow of the Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe
international_collaboration: Society of Interventional Radiology Foundation's Discovery Campaign, Director of Development for the SIR Foundation from 2006-2012, organized six consecutive annual interventional radiology CME meetings in Park City, UT and ten consecutive meetings for interventional radiology and cadiac cath lab nurses and technologists
